title: Krull's principal ideal height bound
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], let $x\in R$, and let $\mathfrak p$ be a prime ideal minimal over $(x)$: $(x)\subseteq\mathfrak p$ and no prime $\mathfrak r$ satisfies $(x)\subseteq\mathfrak r\subsetneq\mathfrak p$. Then $\operatorname{ht}_R(\mathfrak p)\leq1$, where height is the supremum of the lengths $n$ of finite strict prime chains $\mathfrak p_0\subsetneq\cdots\subsetneq\mathfrak p_n\subseteq\mathfrak p$.
